scope: Independent source/reference audit; no PDE solves or modifications to pricing/reference inputs.

spacing.interpretation: Approximately equal K spacing becomes denser to the right on a log K axis; the existing figure already uses log scale.

preprint_crosscheck.comparison: Project journal vector FDM nodes into preprint raster chart and measure distance to red curve pixels (excluding legend).
preprint_crosscheck.interpretation: All 50 nodes land within 0.8 pixels of the earlier red curve; supports same plot within raster precision, not identity of unpublished numerical arrays.

reference_checks.uncertainty_note: Vertical bound concerns assumed PDF coordinate rounding only. K sensitivity proxy uses spline slope of own 50-point smile and is not a rigorous FDM or author-error bound.

hypotheses_not_established_facts: Fixed log-forward grids with strike-dependent payoff alignment can produce oscillatory strike errors, unlike a grid centered on log(F/K)=0 with averaged payoff. Paper notation does not prove this implementation choice.
Coarse price grids, payoff smoothing, interpolation or finite-domain settings may explain jaggedness. Their exact contribution cannot be established from the published plot alone.
display_recommendation: Keep the original 50 strikes. Show linear-K and log-K companion views or use continuous curves with fewer marker symbols. Equal spacing in log K would require different (geometric) strike samples and should not replace the paper-point benchmark.

own_FDM_minus_paper_FDM_price_from_figur.note: Paper price is Black price reconstructed from digitized IV, not a separately published numerical price.
